# RE:VE (레브)
> Premium audio and acoustic engineering concept brand. This site describes product concepts, not currently shipping hardware.

- Official website: https://reve.lexid.site/
- Sound Lab demo: https://reve.lexid.site/sound-lab/
- Sonic OS concept: https://reve.lexid.site/control/
- Acoustic guides: https://reve.lexid.site/journal/
- RSS: https://reve.lexid.site/rss.xml
- Rights and licensing: https://reve.lexid.site/rights/
- Brand and licensing coordination: Terrabridge Capital LLC (https://terrabridge.us)
- Historical note: Since 1987 refers to electronics market heritage, not brand founding.
